frozenSelection.encoding: RFC 4648 Base64 with line wrapping; decode before hashing or JSON review
frozenSelection.sanitization: Only snapshot.root and snapshot.manifest changed from host-absolute project paths to repository-relative paths. Business text, task ID, snapshot content ID, file count, upstream commit, requirements, blindness, freeze time, and status are byte-equivalent JSON values.

identityChain: Frozen selection digest -> path-only sanitized public task -> identical business text in canonical question set -> exact questionSetSha256 in both frozen answers.
